__NOTOC__ Vicious Gladiator's Plate Armor is a collection of plate transmog sets for Warriors. They collect the appearances of the warrior Season 9 armor, along with additional items that match visually but do not grant set bonuses. Collecting either set will grant the Viciously Vintage achievement.
Vial of Liquid Opal is provided for Opals and Runes. It can be traded with Bevrusi in Dornogal in return for a Speakeasy Passrune.

Vials of Healing are found at the lobby of the Dastardly Duos. They grant continuous healing. :

Vicious Bloodstone is a PvP crafting reagent that is used in Khaz Algar Jewelcrafting. They are rare and valuable commodity. They are sold by Hotharn in Dornogal for 2,500 Honor. They can also be looted from War Supply Chests, Unbound Spoils, Alliance bounties, and Horde bounties in The War Within zones. During The War Within seasons, it was also contained in the Glorious Contender's Strongbox.

Virtuous Slippers are part of the Vestments of the Virtuous set, the Dungeon Set 2 for Priests. They can be obtained from the Twilight Boots, Legs, and Shoulders Set, which is a reward for completing the quest Anthion's Parting Words (Season of Discovery).

Virtuous Epaulets are part of the Vestments of the Virtuous set, the Dungeon Set 2 for Priests. They can be obtained from the Twilight Boots, Legs, and Shoulders Set, which is a reward for completing the quest Anthion's Parting Words (Season of Discovery).

Virtuous Cord is part of the Vestments of the Virtuous set, the Dungeon Set 2 for Priests. It can be obtained from the Twilight Gloves and Belt Set, which is a reward for completing the quest Just Compensation (Season of Discovery).

Visages of True Self are mirrors found in Valdrakken. They allow changing appearance. They were also found backstage at the Fashion Frenzy event outside the Caverns of Time in Tanaris during the Bronze Celebration.
Viridian Charmcap is a crafting reagent used in Khaz Algar Alchemy and Khaz Algar Enchanting.
The Violet Goblin Shredder is a shredder mount that has a chance of being awarded after completing a Shipping and Handling streak of 10 jobs at or above Renown 8 with the Cartels of Undermine.

Vintage Kaja'Cola Cans occasionally turn up in S.C.R.A.P. digs in Undermine at Renown 14 or higher with the Cartels of Undermine. They are used as currency for various items with Angelo Rustbin at Hovel Hill alongside Empty Kaja'Cola Can.
Viridian Mechasaur is a mechanical devilsaur battle pet that can be found in a Sifted Pile of Scrap from S.C.R.A.P. piles in Undermine.

Vinnie Sweets is a goblin located in the Demolition Dome in the Undermine. He commentates the battle between Torq and Flarendo during the Liberation of Undermine and later runs the Dastardly Duos event in Isle of Dorn, Stormwind, and Orgrimmar.

Viridescent Spores are a crafting reagent obtained when gathering Sporefused herbs from zones in expansion. Additionally, players with the Skinning profession can craft Sporefused Creature Lure to summon creatures that can drop Viridescent Spores when skinned.
Violet Satchel drops from the Crypt Dweller in the jail area of the Karazhan Crypts. It starts The Violet Satchel.

Vision Manipulator's Cloak is obtained from Horrific Visions Revisited. Explorer gear is obtained by completing a Horrific Vision with 0-4 objectives finished. Adventurer gear is given when a full clear is done with 1-4 masks active, while Veteran gear is rewarded after completion with at least 5 masks active. The cosmetic version is sold by Torie south of the Coreway in Dornogal for 400 Displaced Corrupted Mementos after completing the achievement We Have the Memories.
